applyTo: "**/*.md, **/*.js, **/*.json"
description: "Documentation standards and requirements for the Strapi 5 API"
---

# Documentation Requirements

## Code Documentation

- Write self-explanatory code that minimizes need for comments
- Add comments only for complex business logic or non-obvious implementations
- Use JSDoc for public APIs and complex functions
- Document configuration files and their purposes
- Keep documentation up-to-date with code changes

## API Documentation

- Document all custom API endpoints
- Include request/response examples
- Document authentication requirements
- Specify parameter validation rules
- Use OpenAPI/Swagger specifications where appropriate

## README Files

- Maintain comprehensive README.md for the project
- Include setup instructions for local development
- Document environment variables and configuration
- Provide deployment instructions
- Include troubleshooting section

## Schema Documentation

- Document content type purposes and relationships
- Explain complex field validations
- Document component usage and reusability
- Include examples of proper data structures
- Document any custom field types

## Configuration Documentation

- Document all configuration options in config files
- Explain environment-specific configurations
- Document plugin configurations and their purposes
- Include security configuration explanations
- Document deployment-specific settings

## Process Documentation

- Document development workflow and procedures
- Explain testing procedures and requirements
- Document deployment processes
- Include troubleshooting guides
- Document common maintenance tasks

## Architecture Documentation

- Document system architecture and design decisions
- Explain data flow and relationships
- Document integration points with external systems
- Include database schema documentation
- Document security architecture

## Changelog and Versioning

- Maintain detailed CHANGELOG.md
- Follow semantic versioning
- Document breaking changes clearly
- Include migration guides for major updates
- Document deprecations and their timelines

## Inline Documentation Standards

- Use clear, concise comments
- Explain "why" rather than "what"
- Update comments when code changes
- Remove outdated or misleading comments
- Use consistent comment formatting

## User Documentation

- Provide clear user guides for content creators
- Document admin panel usage
- Include best practices for content management
- Document custom features and their usage
- Provide troubleshooting guides for users
